sub_site: NSCLC lung tissue: tumour, peritumoural and non-malignant distal lung (BAL and saliva not extracted)

evidence.quote: presented before the Thoracic Oncologic Committee of the Centre Jean Perrin (Clermont-Ferrand, France) were preconsidered for inclusion
Following the PCR amplification of the targeted region V3-V4

controls.types: BAL sampling blank (physiological serum); extraction blank (milliQ water)

evidence.quote: During the DNA extraction, milliQ water was used as a negative background control and underwent the same procedure as the real samples. All controls were sequenced and analysed.
The total of 26 negative controls (sampling and background) had in average 21 detected OTU with average of 4 reads/OTU

decontamination.tool: subtraction of control OTU counts per extraction group

evidence.quote: These OTU counts were subtracted from corresponding samples

notes: 18 NSCLC patients; 3 lung tissues each (54) minus 4 tissue samples with <1000 reads = 50 (n inferred). Lung tissue is lung parenchyma/tumour (eligible); BAL and saliva excluded. Control OTU counts subtracted per batch. Streptococcus/Prevotella/Veillonella reported at lower abundance in tissue than BAL. Genera only higher in BAL (Blautia, Capnocytophaga, etc.) not recorded. top5 is pooled across the three lung tissues.
